01 / BIOGRAPHY

Experience built across different fields.

Amin Abdulhaq is an entrepreneur and investor with experience in commercial development, business operations and company-building. Competitive tennis is a defining part of his personal and professional identity.

His interest in business began while studying, when he started an independent trading venture involving the purchase and resale of damaged iPhones through international markets. The experience introduced him to sourcing, pricing differences, negotiation and commercial risk.

He later developed experience in corporate sales, business development and project work before establishing businesses of his own. Alongside his business activities, he built a competitive tennis career from the beginner level, progressing to ITF Masters Tour competition and representing Yemen in the Davis Cup.

04 / COMPETITIVE TENNIS

A serious pursuit beyond business.

A competitive journey that began in 2021 and progressed to ITF Masters Tour competition and representation of Yemen in the Davis Cup.

YemenDavis Cup representation
On court representing Yemen.

Amin began playing tennis in 2021 with no previous playing experience. Through training and competition, he progressed to the ITF Masters Tour and represented Yemen in the Davis Cup.

His official ITF Masters Tour career-high singles ranking was 412 on 17 March 2025. This is an ITF Masters Tour ranking, not an ATP Tour ranking. He continues to develop his tennis career and pursue further coaching education.

05 / FAMILY HERITAGE

A heritage acknowledged. A path developed independently.

Family & legacy

Lessons across generations.

Amin is the grandson of the late Yemeni businessman Shaher Abdulhak. His family heritage forms part of his background and connection to a long-standing commercial legacy.

He recognizes the influence of that heritage while defining his own professional journey through corporate experience, independent ventures and competitive sport.
